summary: Hybrid Speech Architecture Code Review Complete - Frontend-only testing for speech functionality. Code review confirms correct hybrid architecture implementation. The implementation properly delegates to native Capacitor plugin on mobile devices and Web Speech API on desktop. UI integration verified through code inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: speechController.js (lines 1-60): Correctly implements hybrid architecture with Capacitor.isNativePlatform() detection. Lazy-loads hybridSpeechController only on native platforms
hybridSpeechController.js: Properly bridges native and web speech engines with same API interface regardless of platform
nativeSpeechEngine.js: Correctly wraps @capgo/capacitor-speech-recognition plugin with proper event listeners and permission handling
LiveCookingModal.jsx (lines 919-954): Uses async init via speechController.init() for native hybrid support
Mobile audio focus sequencing properly implemented with single audio owner rule (TTS and Recognition cannot run simultaneously)
Session arming mechanism for mobile one-time tap activation working correctly
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing (live-cooking-handsfree-btn, live-cooking-play-btn, etc.)
NOTE: Playwright testing on web only tests Web Speech API path since it runs in browser, not native app

Same API interface regardless of underlying platform

Event listeners for start, end, result, partialResults, error
Language configuration and partial results support
Cleanup function properly removes event listeners

Voice tutorial overlay on first enable
